deckIntent: A data-dense analytical deck positioning climate tech as a $2.8T investment opportunity with specific sector breakdowns, regulatory catalysts, and risk-adjusted return projections. Dark corporate aesthetic with heavy statistical displays, comparative frameworks, and multi-zone content stacking. Every card proves a specific investment thesis with hard numbers and structured analysis.

cards.cardInstructions: OVERVIEW label. Action title: 'Climate Tech Investment Reaches $2.8T Market Opportunity with 23% CAGR Through 2030.' Full dark background with large display text. Below title: 4-stat hero row (total market size, CAGR, deals closed 2024, average Series A). Bottom zone: two-column layout — left column lists 5 key investment sectors with dollar values, right column shows deck structure with page references. Dense opening with at least 3 content zones stacked vertically.

KEY INSIGHTS label. Action title: 'Energy Storage and Carbon Capture Lead $847B in New Funding Commitments.' Primary zone: 3-column sector comparison with dollar amounts, deal counts, and growth rates for top climate tech verticals. Secondary zone: colored accent panel with 4 bullet points on regulatory drivers (IRA, EU taxonomy, carbon pricing). Footer zone: single stat display showing total VC deployment vs traditional energy investment.

ANALYSIS label. Action title: 'Series A Valuations Drop 34% While Late-Stage Climate Deals Increase 67%.' Two-column layout: left shows comparison table with 2023 vs 2024 funding metrics across 6 stage categories, right shows colored analysis panel explaining the flight-to-quality trend. Bottom zone: 3-stat row showing median pre-money, deal velocity, and time-to-exit. Dense data presentation with structured comparisons.

ANALYSIS label. Action title: 'Regulatory Tailwinds Create $340B Addressable Market Expansion in Next 18 Months.' Primary zone: framework diagram showing 4 policy catalysts (IRA extensions, EU CBAM, carbon credit standardization, grid modernization) with dollar impact estimates. Secondary zone: timeline table showing policy implementation dates and market unlocks. Accent-colored callout panel with geographic breakdown of regulatory support.

KEY INSIGHTS label. Action title: 'Hardware Scaling Challenges Limit 73% of Climate Startups to Sub-$50M Revenue.' Three-column challenge analysis: manufacturing scale, supply chain complexity, capital intensity. Each column has challenge description, affected sectors, and typical funding gap. Bottom zone: stats row showing average capital requirements, time-to-commercialization, and failure rates. Colored accent panel with specific examples of scaling bottlenecks.

STRATEGY label. Action title: 'Corporate Venture Arms Deploy $89B in Climate Tech with 2.3x Higher Success Rates.' Primary zone: comparison table showing CVC vs traditional VC performance across 8 metrics (check rate, exit multiples, time to exit, portfolio survival). Secondary zone: colored panel listing top 12 corporate climate investors with deployment amounts. Footer zone: 3-stat display on strategic value creation, partnership velocity, and acquisition premiums.

STRATEGY label. Action title: 'Three Investment Tiers Optimize Risk-Adjusted Returns from 12% to 34% IRR.' Three-column tier framework: Proven Tech (grid storage, solar efficiency), Emerging Scale (direct air capture, green hydrogen), Moonshot Bets (fusion, synthetic biology). Each column shows risk profile, capital requirements, expected returns, and 2-3 example companies. Bottom accent panel with portfolio allocation recommendations and diversification strategy.

CONCLUSION label. Action title: 'Deploy $50-200M Climate Portfolio to Capture 28% IRR with Diversified Sector Exposure.' Opening stats row: recommended allocation, expected IRR, investment horizon, risk-adjusted return. Three-column implementation panel: immediate opportunities (next 6 months), pipeline development (6-18 months), strategic partnerships (12-24 months). Bottom zone: blockquote from leading climate investor with attribution. Dense closing with structured next steps and quantified outcomes.
